evaluation_rule.compactness: height lower, envelope higher; both empty NOT_APPLICABLE; missing nonempty metrics invalidate compactness layer and reject experience
evaluation_rule.hierarchy: first unequal stable completion or volume decides; otherwise count/mass Pareto; only equal loading permits height/envelope Pareto
evaluation_rule.neutral: registered metric equivalence only; not action, box-set or layout identity

gate_rule.benefit: never a gate; complete/empty/instability/explained UNASSESSABLE may continue even if memory loses
gate_rule.continue: only PASS; E and unrelated E each require an actual real-origin nonempty send; no gain test
gate_rule.defer: stop; remaining30 NOT_RUN; explicit later override is a separate recorded authorization
gate_rule.exposure: at least one sent nonempty E and paired unrelated-E body, T coverage reported; absence pauses without replacing sources
gate_rule.static_pressure: do not skip excess demand or unfit items; original per-action physical constraints apply
gate_rule.stop: technical/identity/metric/recovery error, UNKNOWN_SEND, watchdog or cancel stops batch; no replacement task/threshold/card; remaining NOT_RUN
gate_rule.technical: all first-task methods finished, saved-record validated, no STOP category or unknown send
